test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are NOT CORRECT regarding Manganese?

1. Andhra Pradesh has the largest reserves of Manganese in India.

2. Manganese is an important raw material for the smelting of iron ore, and it is also used for manufacturing ferro alloys.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 only**__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **Indian Minerals Yearbook**, **Odisha** holds the largest reserves of **Manganese** in India, accounting for approximately **44 percent** of the total reserves, followed by **Karnataka** (22 percent) and **Madhya Pradesh** (12 percent). **Andhra Pradesh** is a significant producer but does not possess the largest reserves. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
 
• **Manganese** is an indispensable raw material used in the **Iron and Steel industry** for the **smelting of iron ore**. It is primarily used to manufacture **ferro-alloys** like **ferro-manganese** and **silico-manganese**, which impart strength and toughness to steel. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***

 **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manganese** (Mn):
 
 
• It is found in the **Dharwar system** of rocks and is widely distributed in **metamorphic rocks**.
 
• In the **chemical industry**, it is utilized for manufacturing **bleaching powder**, **insecticides**, and **paints**.
 
• It plays a vital role in the production of **dry cell batteries** and is used as a decoloring agent in **glass manufacturing**.
 
• Approximately **10 kilograms** of manganese is required to produce one tonne of **steel**.
 
• Major manganese-producing mines include **Bonai-Keonjhar** in Odisha, **Balaghat-Chhindwara** in Madhya Pradesh, and **Nagpur-Bhandara** in Maharashtra.
